sloka: का त्वम् कांचन वर्ण आभे पीत कौशेय वासिनि ।कमलानाम् शुभाम् मालाम् पद्मिनी इव च बिभ्रती ॥३-४६-१६॥
transliteration: kā tvam kāṁcana varṇa ābhe pīta kauśeya vāsini ।kamalānām śubhām mālām padminī iva ca bibhratī ॥3-46-16॥

translations.english: O lady with a beautiful face, with lovely thighs, are you 'hri', shyness personified? Are you the auspicious lovely Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth? Are you the goddess of fame? Are you an apsara? Are you Bhuti, the goddess of fortune? Or are you Rati, the goddess of love moving at your free will ?
translations.hindi: एतावृपचितोः दृता संहतौ २ संप्रविर्णतों । था पीनान्नतमुखौ कान्तो स्निग्धो ताळफलोपभो
